text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's so no one catches me, early 
morning jogging is—... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No good. I'm feelin' all dizzy. Guess 
tryin' to lose weight all at once really 
was bitin' off more than I could chew...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The same goes for you, Ms. Lala. ...Thank 
you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, as if I'd ever get tired from a 
simple walk. Ohohoho..."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... Was I being too pushy? But still, 
letting it slip that I'm on a diet is 
kinda...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-san. The thing on my desk... was 
that from you?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It's rice porridge. It seemed like you've 
been skipping breakfast lately.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Eating nothing at all might have the 
opposite effect. Please, have some before 
it gets cold.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for makin' ya worry... I'll gladly 
take it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the help of her roommate Believe, 
Lucky Lilac's diet turned out to be a 
success.
